svg.title: CausalLab: a mediator can identify an effect despite hidden confounding
svg.desc: Fixed graph U to X and Y, X to M to Y, with U unobserved. All three sufficient frontdoor conditions pass for M. Added-edge controls fail separate conditions. Under a supplied positive exact synthetic joint, observational P(Y=1|X=0)=41/112 and P(Y=1|X=1)=37/80; the frontdoor functional gives 7/16 and 9/16. Causal interpretation requires the supplied DAG and support assumptions. No graph discovery or sample estimate.
